alerts.headline:
Up to four lanes of southbound I-405 from Northeast Eighth Street (milepost 14.25) to I-90 (milepost 11) 
will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 20 to the morning of 
Wednesday, Oct 21.

Up to four lanes of northbound I-405 from I-90 (milepost 11.5) to Northeast Fourth Street (milepost 13.5) 
will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 20 to the morning of 
Wednesday, Oct. 21.

Up to four lanes of southbound I-405 from Northeast Eighth Street (milepost 14) to Southeast Eighth 
Street (milepost 13) will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to 
the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from 112th Avenue Southeast / Lake Washington Boulevard 
Southeast (milepost 9) to Northeast 44th Street (milepost 7) will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. - 5 
a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 23.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from I-90 (milepost 11.1) to Coal Creek Parkway Southeast (milepost 
10) will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of 
Tuesday, Oct. 20.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Coal Creek Parkway Southeast will be closed overnight from 10:30 
p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. A signed detour 
will be in place.
The right lane of the eastbound I-90 off-ramp to 150th Avenue Southeast will close from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 19, through Friday morning, Oct. 23, for utility work.

The Northeast Sixth Street HOV on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. - 5 
a.m., starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 20 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 21. A signed detour will 
be in place.

The westbound and eastbound SR 520 on-ramps to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 
p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. A signed detour 
will be in place.

The northbound I-405 off-ramps to westbound and eastbound SR 520 will be closed overnight from 11 
p.m. – 4 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. A signed detour 
will be in place.
The southbound I-405 on- and off-ramps at Northeast Sixth Street will close from 11:59 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, to 4:30 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, for maintenance.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to eastbound I-90 will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., 
starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 20 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 21. A signed detour will be in 
place.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to eastbound I-90 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., 
starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 20 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 21. A signed detour will be in 
place.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast Eighth Street will be closed overnight from 9:30 p.m. - 4:45 
a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. A signed detour will be 
in place.

The Northeast 10th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. A signed detour will be in 
place.
The left lane of southbound I-405 will close from 11:59 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, to 4:30 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, near Northeast 12th Street (milepost 14-13) for maintenance.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from I-90 (milepost 10.5) to milepost 12 will be closed overnight 
from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20.
The left two lanes of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, near Northeast 40th Street (milepost 16-15) for maintenance.
The left lane of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Monday, Oct. 19, to 5 a.m. Tuesday, Oct. 20, near SR 527/Bothell-Everett Highway (milepost 26-25) for maintenance.
The left lane of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 23, near 213th Street Southeast (milepost 28-27) for maintenance.

Two lanes of eastbound SR 522 between Campus Way Northeast (milepost 10.4) and milepost 11.15 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19 to Friday morning, Oct. 23.
Up to two right lanes of northbound SR 527 between mileposts 2.6 and 2.9 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Friday morning, Oct. 23.

Crews will intermittently close a mile of the tolled lanes on southbound I-405 between Lynnwood and Bellevue from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly this week and next week for toll equipment maintenance work. 
The work will start Thursday, Oct. 15 near I-5 in Lynnwood. It will pause over the weekend and pick up again in Bothell on the evening of Monday, Oct. 19. Crews will proceed south each night until reaching the end of the tolled lanes in Bellevue on the morning of Thursday, Oct. 22.

The left express toll lane of southbound I-405 between SR 522 (milepost 23.47) and milepost 20.7 will be closed nightly from 8 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Thursday morning, Oct. 22.

The left express toll lane of northbound I-405 between SR 522 (milepost 23.5) and SR 527 (milepost 27.1) will be closed nightly from 8:30 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Friday morning, Oct. 23.
The Northeast 160th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Thursday morning, Oct. 22.
The northbound SR 527 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Friday morning, Oct. 23.
The northbound SR 527 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Friday morning, Oct. 23.
The Northeast 160th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Thursday morning, Oct. 22.
The left two lanes of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Monday, Oct. 19, to 5 a.m. Tuesday, Oct. 20, near Northeast 160th Street (milepost 23-22) for maintenance.
The left lane of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 23, near Northeast 160th Street (milepost 23-22) for maintenance.
Northbound and southbound SR 203 will alternate over the Tolt River Bridge from noon to 5 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, for inspection.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.
The left two lanes of northbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 23, near Northeast 116th Street (milepost 20-19) for maintenance.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between Northeast 128th Street (milepost 21.43) and milepost 22.5 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 19, to Thursday morning, Oct. 22.
The left two lanes of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 20, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, near Northeast 160th Street (milepost 23-22) for maintenance.
The southbound I-405 on- and off-ramps at Northeast 128th Street will close from 11:59 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 20, to 4:30 a.m. Oct. 21, for maintenance.

Both directions of State Route 161 in Federal Way and Milton will reduce to one lane from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 19, through Friday morning, Oct. 23, between South 370th Street and Military Road South for construction. 

At least one lane of SR 161 will remain open through this area each night.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from North 30th Street (milepost 6) to Talbot Road South / SR 515 
(milepost 3) will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to 
the morning of Friday, Oct. 23.

Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from Northeast 44th Street (milepost 7) to 112th Avenue Southeast / Lake Washington Boulevard Southeast (milepost 9) will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 1 a.m., starting 
the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 23.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. Signed detours will be in place.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. Signed detours will be in place.

The Sunset Boulevard North / SR 900 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. -
5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 21. A signed detour will 
be in place.

The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. -
4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. Signed 
detours will be in place.

The Northeast 44th Street on-ramps to northbound I-405 and southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Tuesday, Oct. 20. Signed detours will be in place.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 23. A signed detour will be in place.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from SR 169 (milepost 4) to Sunset Boulevard North / SR 900 (milepost 5.5) will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 19 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 23.
The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.

Monday, Oct. 5, on most weeknights until Friday, Oct. 23 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The ramp will reopen at 6 a.m. each of the following mornings. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on westbound SR 520 past the Montlake and Lake Washington boulevard exits will detour to southbound I-5.

The northbound I-5 off-ramp to Corson-Michigan will close from 10 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 20, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, for maintenance. A signed detour will loop around at West Seattle/Columbia and use the southbound I-5 off-ramp to Corson-Michigan.

Monday, Oct. 19, nightly until the morning of Friday, Oct. 23 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction beginning at 10 p.m. The ramp will reopen at 6 a.m. each of the following mornings. During the time the ramp is closed, all traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 will cross Lake Washington and pay the bridge toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need to access Montlake from I-5 must use alternate routes.
Eastbound and westbound US 2 will alternate from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. nightly Wednesday, Oct. 21, through Friday morning, Oct. 23, near the Skykomish city limits (milepost 49) for guardrail repair.

Daily from 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 2:30 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers at Sky Lane (milepost 49) for maintenance. This work may also need to occur on Tuesday, Oct. 20 and Wednesday, Oct. 21.
The right lane of both directions of Tukwila International Boulevard will close beneath SR 99 from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Tuesday and Wednesday, Oct. 20-21, for maintenance.

Up to two general-purpose lanes of westbound SR 522 between I-405 (milepost 11.6) and Campus Way Northeast (milepost 10.6) will be closed nightly from 9:30 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. Monday night, Oct. 19, to Friday morning, Oct. 23.

The right lane of westbound SR 536 will close from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday, Oct. 18, through Tuesday morning, Oct. 20, and at the same times Wednesday, Oct. 21, through Saturday morning, Oct. 24, near Fifth Avenue West (milepost 2-3) for utility work.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.
Northbound and southbound SR 203 will alternate from 7:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 22, south of Tualco Road (milepost 22) for maintenance.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings beginning Monday, July 27, one lane of State Route 203 will be closed for a paving project between just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20). Flaggers and pilot cars will direct alternating traffic through the remaining open lane.

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
Eastbound and westbound SR 96 will alternate from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily through Friday, Oct. 23, near Lark Dairy Farm (milepost 6) for utility work.
The right lane of southbound SR 9 will close from 8:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily Wednesday and Thursday, Oct. 21-22, south of Marsh Road (milepost 8-7) for maintenance.
Eastbound and westbound SR 96 will alternate from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily Mondays through Fridays through Friday, Oct. 23, near Lark Dairy Farm (milepost 6) for utility work.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
From 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Tuesday and Wednesday, Oct. 20-21, contractors will close the right turn lane of westbound US 2 at Old Owen Road. Traffic can still turn right using the travel-through lane.
